# e2e-testing

Use when the user asks for e2e testing work.

## Workflow
1. Choose critical user journeys.
2. Use resilient selectors, deterministic fixtures and isolated test data.
3. Cover success, validation failures, accessibility and loading states.
4. Avoid fixed sleeps when condition waits suffice.
5. Provide steps to run locally.

## Verification
State which checks were executed, what passed, and what could not be verified. Favor existing project conventions. Use local resources; do not require network access merely to read this skill.
